name: Apple, the company
description: Capital A. Get from a pie to the company.
lesson: GPT-2 keeps “␣apple” and “␣Apple” as two tokens with two rows of numbers. ␣Apple sits with ␣iPhone and ␣iOS. Even lower-case ␣apple is pulled most of the way there: the web pages GPT-2 learned from talk about the company far more than the fruit.

name: Python, the language
description: From a snake to the programming language.
lesson: Even lower-case ␣python sits with programming, next to ␣Py and ␣Django. Programmers write the name in lower case, and GPT-2's training text had far more code talk than zoology.

name: Curiosity, the rover
description: From wonder to the robot on Mars.
hint: The capital C is a machine.
lesson: Lower-case ␣curiosity is the feeling; capital ␣Curiosity is NASA's Mars rover, sitting with ␣rover and ␣Martian. Same letters, different token, different neighbourhood. Adding ␣curiosity alone leaves the rover far off.

name: The Grateful Dead
hint: Capitalised, it's mostly half of a band's name.
lesson: Capital ␣Grateful sits with ␣Beatles and Jerry (Garcia): GPT-2 mostly met it in “Grateful Dead”. Lower-case ␣grateful still just means thankful.

name: Bush, the president
description: From a tree to the politician.
lesson: ␣bush is a plant; ␣Bush sits with ␣Obama, ␣Gore and ␣Cheney. News text made the capital-B token a politician.

name: The Globe
description: From a map to the newspaper.
lesson: ␣globe is a sphere; ␣Globe sits with ␣Herald, ␣Tribune and ␣Times. To GPT-2 it's mostly a newspaper name, as in the Boston Globe.

name: Turkey, the country
hint: Its biggest city, and a neighbour.
lesson: ␣Turkey sits with ␣Ankara and ␣Istanbul; lower-case ␣turkey is the bird. The bird gets you only partway, but with ␣Istanbul and ␣Syria it helps: the two rows still share something.

name: Amazon, the shop
description: From rain to the company, not the forest.
lesson: The rainforest and the river are in GPT-2's text too, but ␣Amazon sits with ␣AWS, ␣Alexa and ␣Kindle. Adding ␣river makes things worse.

name: Jaguar, the car
description: From a kitten to the car maker.
lesson: ␣Jaguar's neighbours are ␣Rover, ␣Corvette and ␣Toyota: the car brand, not the cat. Adding ␣cat barely moves you.

name: -ologist
description: The jack is a piece of a word.
hint: What does an -ologist do all day?
lesson: “ologist” never stands alone (␣biologist and ␣psychologist are single tokens; it turns up inside rarer words), yet it sits with ␣scientist and ology. A piece carries a meaning: here, “expert in”.

name: -ness
description: A piece that carries grammar, not a topic.
hint: Other pieces that turn words into nouns.
lesson: “kindness” at the start of a line is kind + ness. The piece ness sits with other noun endings (ity, iness, ment): it carries grammar, not a subject. Those pieces get you there; the whole word ␣kindness doesn't.

name: -ville
description: From a village to a place-name ending.
lesson: “ville” ends place names GPT-2 doesn't store whole: “ Smallville” is ␣Small + ville. It sits with burg and bury, so other endings get you there faster than the word ␣town.

name: Espresso, in pieces
description: From tea to the end of “espresso”.
hint: Take the tea out of tea.
lesson: Mid-sentence, “ espresso” is one token, but at the start of a line it's esp + resso. The piece resso still sits with ␣espresso, ␣Coffee and ␣Starbucks: a piece inherits the meaning of the words it finishes.

name: SolidGoldMagikarp
description: The famous glitch token. What does it mean to GPT-2?
hint: Its real meaning won't help. What else was barely trained?
lesson: It's a Reddit username that was common in the text used to build the tokenizer but almost absent from the text GPT-2 trained on, so its row barely moved from where it started. Its real meaning doesn't help: ␣Reddit leaves it far away. Only other barely-trained usernames (␣TheNitromeFan, ␣davidjl) get close, because untrained tokens cluster together.
